title: Pin the edition of every text
statement: Pin the exact edition or translation of every source text, since its reading level and its rights can differ from one edition to the next.
example: One translation of a book is documented at 800L, while other translations run 1200L.
detail: Research into public-domain books for the reading course found one translation of a book documented at 800L while other translations run 1200L, and pinned that translation by its year. It also found that for some series only the original edition's text is in the public domain, while the revised editions everyone knows are still under copyright.

I’m looking for it and including the full Folger text as a clearly labelled reference.
Do not infer that the play’s public-domain status resolves every edition, illustration, recording, or packaging right.
